text_block_list.text: And then, there's that overwhelmingly fierce passion...

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Next time, I'm gonna be in there with them!
—Definitely!!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Trainer, keep your eyes on me, okay?!

Tsuyoshi... is gonna get way, way faster!

text_block_list.text:
Powering up both my diet and my training!!
Just you wait, everyone~!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Ohh! That's right, I've gotta overtake them!!

text_block_list.text:

Allllriiiiiiight!!

in first place will be this Tsuyoshi~!!"
